name: Western capercaillie
desc: Huge grouse of the old pinewoods, feeding on pine shoots and bilberry; its eggs, chicks and adults are taken by predators.
about: The western capercaillie, also known as the Eurasian capercaillie, wood grouse, heather cock, cock-of-the-woods, or simply capercaillie , is a heavy member of the grouse tribe and the largest of all…
